networkfit.help: Fits a stochastic network model (Baumeier et al., Phys. Rev. B 86, 184202 (2012)) to the sites, site energies and couplings of a state file and writes the parameter file for networkgen

job_name.help: Input file name without extension, also used for the default file names

statefile.help: State file with site energies and couplings, if not given job_name.hdf5

frame.help: Frame of the state file; -1: the first

carriers.help: Carrier types to fit (at most two are correlated with each other)

parameterfile.help: Parameter file to write, if not given job_name_network.xml

energyfile.help: Optional ASCII file with positions and site energies of the microscopic system, and for each carrier whether the site belongs to one of its traps

statsfile.help: Optional ASCII file with the fitted functions (microscopic, model) for plots

bin.help: Width of the distance bins of all distance dependent functions

correlationcutoff.help: Largest distance for the energy correlation fit; 0: half the box

l_b.help: Grid of the short-range moving average: first, last, step

l_c.help: Grid of the long-range moving average: first, last, step (values above the number of sites are skipped)

quantiles.help: Number of quantiles of the standardized coupling residuals; 0: Gaussian

fit.help: Fit the point process; false: use the values below

realizations.help: Realizations averaged per evaluation of the fit

evaluations.help: Largest number of evaluations of the fit

candidates.help: Candidate points per iteration, in units of the number of sites

maxiterations.help: Largest number of iterations of the point process

radiusmean.help: Mean of the random part of the radii if not fitted

radiusvariance.help: Variance of the random part of the radii if not fitted

traps.help: Traps (single sites or clusters) from the slow modes of the master equation at temperature and zero field (spectral method of Chen, van der Hoorn and Baumeier): left out of the bulk energy statistics and stored as templates that networkgen inserts

find.help: Identify traps; false: all sites are bulk

threshold.help: Sites whose normalized density-mode entry exceeds this belong to a trap (the parameter a of the paper)

gap.help: A trap releases a carrier at least this many times slower than the first fast mode of the network relaxes

mass.help: A trap carries at least this fraction of the weight of its side of the slow density mode

maxsize.help: Largest number of sites of a trap

maxsites.help: Largest number of sites for the dense eigenvalue problem

seed.help: Seed of the random numbers of the fit and of the parameter file

validate.help: Number of model networks of the same size whose statistics are compared with the microscopic system (mean and standard deviation over the networks); 0: none

temperature.help: Temperature of the rates for the trap identification and of the finite-size check of the density of states
